findings.highlight: I feel good
findings.evidenceJa: いたって健康だし
findings.governingReading: I am in perfect health
findings.explanation: Shirou’s emphatic and plainly dubious self-assessment is weakened.

findings.highlight: We’ve been like this
findings.evidenceJa: 互いを気にしている
findings.governingReading: we have spent the hour silently watching and worrying about each other
findings.explanation: The mutual concern sustaining the silence disappears.

findings.highlight: No matter what the results may be
findings.evidenceJa: うち倒すか倒されるか
findings.governingReading: Whether we strike him down or are struck down ourselves
findings.explanation: The two fatal outcomes are replaced by generic results.

findings.highlight: the three of us won’t be able to talk like this
findings.evidenceJa: 三人で話し合う事はない
findings.governingReading: the three of us will never sit and talk together like this again
findings.explanation: A certain future separation becomes an unexplained inability.

findings.highlight: too busy with all the events that came up
findings.evidenceJa: 次から次に起こる出来事に翻弄された
findings.governingReading: buffeted helplessly by one event after another
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of control becomes mere busyness.

findings.highlight: he was a twisted guy
findings.evidenceJa: 酷いヤツだった
findings.governingReading: he was awful
findings.explanation: Rin’s blunt condemnation of Archer becomes a claim that he was psychologically warped.

findings.highlight: I intuitively know that the Holy Grail shouldn’t exist
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツが使うという聖杯も、在ってはならない物だと直感している
findings.governingReading: I sense that the Grail Gilgamesh says he will use is something that must not exist
findings.explanation: The judgment loses its immediate link to Gilgamesh’s stated use of this Grail.

findings.highlight: The man who only denied Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎を否定する為だけに在り続けた男
findings.governingReading: the man who continued to exist solely to deny Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: Archer’s entire continued existence and purpose are reduced to repeated disagreement.

findings.highlight: Her hesitation and reluctance
findings.evidenceJa: その迷い、未練
findings.governingReading: that doubt and lingering attachment
findings.explanation: Saber’s unresolved attachment to the Grail becomes generic reluctance.

findings.highlight: I tie it behind my back and roll up my sleeves
findings.evidenceJa: きっちりと紐を結んで、気合いをいれて腕まくりをする
findings.governingReading: I tie the strings tight, steel myself, and roll up my sleeves
findings.explanation: The precision and deliberate burst of resolve behind Shirou’s cooking ritual disappear.

findings.highlight: start preparing dinner
findings.evidenceJa: テキパキと夕食の支度をする
findings.governingReading: briskly and efficiently prepare dinner
findings.explanation: Shirou’s practiced household competence is omitted.

findings.highlight: I’ll forget about everything tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 今日は無礼講だ
findings.governingReading: Tonight, all restraint and formality are off
findings.explanation: A festive suspension of rules becomes Shirou trying to forget his circumstances.

findings.highlight: I’ll make a delicious feast
findings.evidenceJa: 思いっきり豪勢に行こう
findings.governingReading: I will make it as lavish as possible
findings.explanation: Abundance and extravagance are changed into flavor quality.

findings.highlight: doing our best to keep it like always and to have a good dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯騒々しく、夕食を迎えられるよう張り切る
findings.governingReading: we throw ourselves into making enough noise to welcome dinner as usual
findings.explanation: Their deliberate noisy performance against the grief of their final night disappears.

findings.highlight: dinner consisting of Western, Chinese, and Japanese food
findings.evidenceJa: 和洋中と節操のない夕食
findings.governingReading: a shamelessly indiscriminate Japanese-Western-Chinese dinner
findings.explanation: The joke that the menu ignores all culinary coherence disappears.

findings.highlight: I was using a familiar to spy on that place
findings.evidenceJa: キャスター対策で監視役の使い魔を放ってた
findings.governingReading: I had deployed a familiar to watch the site as a countermeasure against Caster
findings.explanation: Rin’s stated reason and tactical foresight disappear.

findings.highlight: has to implant the heart into a magus’s body
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度魔術師の体に埋め込まないといけない
findings.governingReading: has to implant it once more into a magus’s body
findings.explanation: The restoration of a previously embodied Grail mechanism is presented as first-time implantation.

findings.highlight: The boundary field on the Ryuudou Temple is meaningless for you two
findings.evidenceJa: マスターである二人なら、柳洞寺の結界も意味はない
findings.governingReading: For the two of you as Masters, Ryuudou Temple’s barrier has no effect
findings.explanation: The specific status that lets Rin and Shirou bypass the bounded field disappears.

findings.highlight: You seem to think pretty highly of him
findings.evidenceJa: やけにアイツの肩を持つ
findings.governingReading: you are strangely quick to take his side
findings.explanation: Rin’s accusation of siding with Gilgamesh becomes admiration for him.

findings.highlight: such a hopeless battle
findings.evidenceJa: そんな無謀な戦い
findings.governingReading: such a reckless battle
findings.explanation: Shirou’s judgment that the plan is unacceptably reckless becomes a prediction that victory is impossible.

findings.highlight: She’s been acting strange
findings.evidenceJa: なにしてんだあいつ
findings.governingReading: What is she doing? She has been acting strange
findings.explanation: Shirou’s immediate baffled question disappears.

findings.highlight: She yells at me
findings.evidenceJa: よく分からない罵倒を返し
findings.governingReading: she answers with an insult I cannot quite make sense of
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic inability to understand Rin’s outburst disappears.

findings.highlight: as our “brain”, Tohsaka, won’t talk
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂というブレインを欠いた俺たち
findings.governingReading: the two of us, deprived of our strategist Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Lack of Rin’s intellectual participation becomes a deliberate refusal to speak.

findings.highlight: Our course of action is decided by Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の独断で、方針は決定してしまった
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka unilaterally settles our course of action
findings.explanation: Rin’s unilateral authority and the narrator’s sense of a fait accompli disappear.

findings.highlight: settle our score with that Servant
findings.evidenceJa: あのサーヴァントと決着をつける
findings.governingReading: bring the confrontation with that Servant to its conclusion
findings.explanation: A necessary final battle becomes a personal vendetta.
